description: Casts a server-time horary chart, checks chart fitness, and returns an auditable structural judgment plus outcome-confirmation hook. For 'when will I be promoted' or 'when will I get a job' (category career), pass seedNumber (the person's own pick from 1 to 249) to get KP Reader VI dated windows in timingWindows; without it, or when the chart is unfit or the promotion or job is not promised, judgmentDimensions.timing explains why no date is given. Job-change questions are not timed. Never supply dates that timingWindows does not contain.

place.description: Catalogue query or display label when explicit coordinates are supplied

referenceHouse.description: House of the person the question concerns (1 = the querent, 7 = spouse or other party, 10 = employer)

seedNumber.description: KP horary number chosen by the person asking; enables KP/Nadi results and Reader VI promotion and job timing

timezone.description: Required IANA timezone when explicit coordinates are supplied, for example Asia/Kolkata

timezoneOffset.description: Optional fallback offset; derived from timezone and the requested local date when omitted

tradition.description: integrated compares traditions; prashna-nadi is KP/Nadi and requires seedNumber

name: calculate_prashna
title: Ask a Prashna question
